description: Independently implemented Rifare consumer subset. This describes the local adapter, not a copy of the upstream schemas or a qualified public Gateway transport.

functions.encodeDelegatedCommand: Validate a full closed request from an object or original UTF-8 bytes, detach and freeze it, serialize using the native canonical owner and supply original command identity/digest. For recovery, command_digest is the referenced original digest, never a digest of the recovery request.
functions.createDelegatedRecovery: Construct a recovery request from the retained complete original START_USE or FINALIZE_USE mutation, without creating an identity or deciding whether another attempt is allowed.
functions.bindDelegatedResponse: Validate a successful raw response against the retained complete original mutation. Optional recovery is the exact recovery request; optional previous is the earlier raw successful response. Both are independently validated. Explicit recovery requires recovered=true; a direct response permits either flag.
functions.correlateDelegatedReceipt: Rebind a FINAL_USE response and compare its receipt digest against the exact supplied compact-JWS bytes. Return only a digest-matched observation without retaining the token or authenticating its signature.

input_bounds.revision: Positive safe integer 1..9007199254740991. Original numeric wire spellings are nonnegative decimal integers; exponent/fraction spellings are unsupported.
input_bounds.uuid: Original lowercase canonical hyphenated non-nil UUID; no trimming or repair.
input_bounds.uri: Original absolute ASCII URI, nonempty scheme-specific part, no wildcard, whitespace, backslash, malformed percent escape or invalid component character. HTTP(S) requires explicit nonempty authority. Syntax validation never serializes a normalized URL and never fetches a reference.
input_bounds.time: Native calendar-valid UTC Z subset, positive four-digit year and optional 1..9 fractional digits; original spelling retained. End must be strictly after start. Historical expiry is not current-authority validation.
input_bounds.digest: Exact sha256: prefix followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
input_bounds.json: Native strict duplicate-aware fatal UTF-8 decoding and descriptor-checked frozen snapshots; unknown/null/foreign fields fail closed. The inherited scanner counts each whitespace character as a step, so documents under the byte ceiling can still exceed the scan limit. No unsupported command or result fallback.

binding.mutation: Digest of the complete validated mutation via existing native canonical/contentDigest; the fixed ASCII field-name and safe-integer subset is not arbitrary RFC 8785 qualification.
binding.start: CHALLENGE result; exact original grant and every operation field. The challenge UUID is not a signed proof nonce.
binding.finalize: FINAL_USE result; exact original challenge, PERMIT or DENY and EVIDENCE_ONLY. Digest correlation does not prove the proof submission's producer or contents.
binding.recovery: Original command UUID/digest plus the original mutation's result kind and grant/operation/challenge checks. A prior response allows only recovered to differ; all original result values, timestamp spellings, receipt metadata and decision remain unchanged.

effects: Pure bounded data processing. No clock-based authority refresh, network, URI retrieval, retry, ID generation, key/trust configuration, storage, command claim, receipt-context source, purchase, payment or native commerce transition.
privacy: Transient bounded process data only. No logging or persistence. Receipt bytes are used only for the synchronous exact-byte digest comparison and are absent from outputs; physical memory zeroization is not claimed.
remaining: current external authority and proof sources
durable original command claims and reconciliation
